name: Bookie BC API Extension
brief: Read-only API endpoints that let Bookie show exact balances, amounts due and payments from Business Central
description: Adds the custom API api/knowallBookie/bookie/v1.0 for the Bookie accounting portal (getbook.ie): bank balances and bank ledger entries, customer and vendor ledger entries with remaining amounts, posted payments, financial report lines, company setup, and customer payment registration.
